lines: Hello! I'm Miss Marigold. We whisper in the library.
Get your lantern at my stall! They go up at nine.
Shh. They always drift towards the old oak. Curious!
I read to the ducks after work. Just the good bits.
Kip sorted the books by colour. I'll fix it tomorrow.

rotate: The books about the old oak? All borrowed. Again.
An old book says the oak grows 'where the two clocks meet'.
Mrs. Wren returned a book forty years late!
A scary book? Read it with a friend.
